name: Ceramic Vase With Glass Flowers
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality ceramic and paired with handcrafted glass flowers, creating an elegant and meaningful decorative gift set.
    - The vase is made from durable ceramic with a smooth finished surface and a classic rounded silhouette.
    - Features a charming rustic jute rope accent around the neck for a warm, natural decorative touch.
    - Includes delicate handcrafted glass flowers with artistic detail and vibrant color.
    - Available with multiple birth flower inspired styles.
    - Each flower is designed with a flexible wire stem, making it easy to bend, arrange, or trim as needed.
    - Combines decorative beauty, sentimental value, and keepsake appeal in one unique display piece.
    📌 Note: Glass flowers are only available with the purchase of a ceramic vase and cannot be purchased separately.

 

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Ceramic vase size:
              +) Top diameter: 4.5 cm ~ 1.77 in
              +) Bottom width: 6.5 cm ~ 2.55 in
              +) Body height: 9 cm ~ 3.54 in
              +) Total height: 12.5 cm ~ 4.92 in
              +) Neck height: 2 cm ~ 0.78 in
    - Capacity: Approx. 10–11 fl oz
    - Glass flower size: Approx. 20.3 cm ~ 8 in length
    📌 Note:  The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customise only the printed design.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses full-surface UV printing for sharp details, vibrant colors, and a long-lasting finish.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a decorative ceramic vase and a personalized keepsake gift.
    - Designed for display on desks, shelves, bedside tables, office tables, mantels, and memory corners.
    - Suitable for teacher appreciation gifts, home décor, office décor, birthday gifts, and sentimental keepsake displays.
    - The included glass flowers offer a lasting floral arrangement without the maintenance of real flowers.
    - Perfect for adding a heartfelt, artistic, and elegant touch to everyday spaces.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for teachers, moms, grandmothers, friends, coworkers, family members, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for Teacher Appreciation Day, birthdays, Mother’s Day, holidays, thank-you gifts, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for anyone who loves floral décor, ceramic keepsakes, and personalized gifts.
    - Great for desk décor, classroom gifts, office gifts, shelf display, and sentimental home decoration.
    - A thoughtful gift that combines beauty, encouragement, and lasting decorative value.
    - Adds a warm, elegant, and memorable touch to any space.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7-15 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Ceramic Vase With Glass Flowers

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
